setup: s.level = Math.max(3, s.level); fill(3); return s.triggerChaos('carl');
after: const v = s.visitors.find(v => v.kind==='carl'); const from = {x: -5.75, z: 2.4}; const dir = 1; v.status='flying'; v.timer=0.42; v.from=from; v.impact={x: from.x + dir*2.6, z: from.z}; v.x=(from.x+v.impact.x)/2; v.z=from.z; v.angle = Math.atan2(dir, 0); const c = s.coach; c.x = -8.2; c.z = 4.6; c.vx = 6; c.vz = -2.5; c.angle = Math.atan2(6, -2.5); return true;
